verdicts.rationale: The API check found no API or developer page on the features pages, nav or footer, and the features index lists no API page (c9), so no API is shown.
verdicts.missing: Any public API documentation, developer portal or even a claim of an API for investors, offerings, distributions or documents.

verdicts.rationale: No item mentions an MCP server, and neither the site nor the Help Center has a developer section where one would be documented.
verdicts.missing: Any official MCP server, its documentation or setup steps.

verdicts.rationale: No item shows an SDK, CLI, package or public repository, and no API or developer page was found.
verdicts.missing: Any vendor-maintained SDK or CLI on a public package registry or repository, or even code samples.

verdicts.rationale: The features index lists no API, webhook or integration page (c9), and no item describes webhooks or event subscriptions.
verdicts.missing: Any documented webhooks or event subscriptions for investors, offerings, distributions or documents, including through a third-party automation platform.

verdicts.rationale: No API was found, and no item shows API keys, tokens or OAuth clients, scoped or otherwise.
verdicts.missing: Any API credential an agent could obtain and documentation of scopes, roles or permissions that limit it.

verdicts.rationale: No item shows an OpenAPI, Swagger, GraphQL or other machine-readable spec, and no API documentation was found to carry one.
verdicts.missing: Any machine-readable API specification, public or behind a login.

verdicts.rationale: A probe fetched an llms.txt for the Help Center, the product's documentation, which returned 200 with 44,437 bytes under the heading 'Groundbreaker | Help Center' (p1).
verdicts.missing: Only the file's title line and size are shown, not which Help Center articles it lists or whether it covers both the Manager Platform Guide and Investor Portal Guide collections.

verdicts.rationale: No item shows a sandbox, test mode or developer environment, and no API or developer page was found.
verdicts.missing: Any self-serve or on-request sandbox, test mode or developer environment.

verdicts.rationale: The only download shown is investors downloading documents from the Investor Dashboard (c7), and no bulk export of the sponsor's records in an open format is described.
verdicts.missing: Any self-serve export of investors, commitments, distributions or other records in CSV, Excel or JSON, and documentation of it.

verdicts.rationale: The plans page offers only 'Join the Waitlist' and 'Schedule a Demo' (c3), so no self-serve sign-up or free trial is shown.
verdicts.missing: Any self-serve sign-up, paid-plan checkout or free trial that needs no call.

verdicts.rationale: The plans page shows no price figures, only waitlist and demo buttons (c3).
verdicts.missing: Any plan prices, fees or even a starting price.

verdicts.rationale: The subscription process appears only as an app feature (c6), and no item shows an API or integration for creating investors or sending subscription documents.
verdicts.missing: API documentation for creating investor records and for sending or starting subscription documents, directly or through a third-party integration.

verdicts.rationale: Distributions and notices appear only as in-app actions an authorized person completes 'with a few clicks' (c4, c5), with no API route to read or create distributions or generate notices.
verdicts.missing: Any API endpoint to read or create distributions or to generate or send investor notices.

verdicts.rationale: No item shows an API endpoint or any export, documented or manual, that returns investors, commitments or contributions.
verdicts.missing: Any API or export (JSON or CSV) of the investor register, including commitments and contributions.
